name: 床上滴蜡 · 手持蜡烛
description: 她仰躺在床上、双手被举过头顶绑在床头、双腿微曲；身上是情趣服装、胸前有调教道具；戴黑色皮手套的手举着一支燃着的蜡烛，蜡油正沿胸口与小腹往下淌；她翻白眼大张着嘴，泪与汗交叠
pose_tags: on back, open mouth, partially undressed, ahegao, rolled back eyes, slave, shibari, bound wrists, wrists bound above her head, candle wax, wax dripping, holding candle, female hand, pov, sweat
pose_nl: she lies on her back with her wrists bound above her head. a gloved hand holds a candle above her and wax drips onto her skin. candlelight flickers across the bed.
